title: Mobile car detailing
notes: Provider-published information, not an endorsement or independent service-quality verification. Starting prices cover different scopes and vehicle sizes. Confirm final quote, address coverage and availability directly. No paid placements or partner agreements exist.

listings.name: Pearl's Auto Recon
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider says it brings water and rechargeable power. A safe parking space is required.

interiorPrice.scope: Small car or SUV; larger vehicles cost more.

fullPrice.scope: Maintenance refresh for a small car or SUV, not the deep-clean package.

listings.petHairNote: For extensive pet hair or other extreme conditions, the provider asks for a quote request first.

listings.name: Detling's Detailing
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider requests an outdoor water spigot, standard power outlet and parking space.

interiorPrice.scope: Larger vehicles and heavier messes add to the price.

listings.petHairNote: Pet hair removal is separately priced; mention pets when requesting a quote.

listings.name: 513 Auto Clean
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider asks customers to discuss water or power questions when booking; self-contained equipment is not confirmed.

interiorPrice.scope: Basic cleanup; excludes upholstery shampoo/extraction and deep stain treatment. Larger or heavily soiled vehicles may vary.

listings.petHairNote: Pet hair work is available; package scope and additional treatment depend on severity.

listings.name: OG Mobile Detailing
listings.waterPowerNote: Water and power requirements are not stated in the reviewed page.

interiorPrice.scope: Published starting price; confirm vehicle size and condition.

listings.name: deets mobile detailing
listings.waterPowerNote: Equipment is brought to the appointment, but water and power requirements need confirmation.

interiorPrice.scope: Published starting price; confirm vehicle size and condition.

fullPrice.scope: Published starting price; confirm package scope and final quote.

listings.name: Precision Gloss
listings.waterPowerNote: Water and power requirements are not stated in the reviewed page.

listings.name: Z&G Mobile Detailing
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider requires customer water and electricity within 100 feet of the vehicle. Its submission says some packages need electricity only; confirm requirements for your package.

interiorPrice.scope: Coupe starting price. Includes vacuuming, steam cleaning, seat shampoo/conditioning and interior cleaning. Larger vehicles and extras cost more; confirm the final quote.

fullPrice.scope: Coupe starting price for interior and exterior detailing. Confirm vehicle size, condition, extras and final quote.

listings.petHairNote: Pet-hair removal is an add-on; confirm the charge for your vehicle and condition.
listings.serviceAreaNote: Cincinnati and surrounding areas; confirm service at your address.
